messages.author: 0ef8781bf44e6651
messages.subject: Counters in Rhipe
parts:
Hi, I cant get counters to work a all, Any ideas?

map <- expression({       
    f <- table( do.call(rbind,strsplit(unlist(map.values),','))[,6] )
    rhcounter("BLOCK","TOTAL",1)
    sapply(names(f),function(r) if(r!='Product') rhcollect(r,NULL))
})
reduce <- expression({ rhcounter("COUNT","PRODUCTS",1) })
job <- rhmr(map=map, reduce=reduce, inout=c("text"), ifolder="/tmp/ok.csv")
result <- rhstatus(rhex(job,async=TRUE))


Now result$counters shows no BLOCK or COUNT category.

Thanks, i thought a expression without any variables would default to reduce. I guess i was wrong. I see REDUCE/TOTAL=44 exactly what i wanted.
Also could you please tell me where do i check for status messages, like i recently put this in my reduce expression 

rhstatus(sprintf("got reduce grouping for %s",reduce.key))

But i couldn't find this message anywhere, I greped the hadoop logs for starters.

I am finding Rhipe nice, more tightly integrated and with very less baggage than other projects like rhadoop which are mess to setup in first place. IMO a wiki page explaining what map.key, reduce.key and map.values,reduce.values are? specifically what R type they are would help getiing started for newbies much better. 
Just my 2 cents.

Thanks
